# Accepted path references — read by check-paths.mjs, one per line:
#
#   <path>:<line>|<detector>|<reason>
#
# The reason is required and lives on the same line, so accepting a reference
# shows up in the diff that accepts it, with its justification beside it. An
# entry that matches nothing is reported as stale — the reference it excused has
# moved or gone, and the entry must go with it.
#
# This record sits beside the check rather than at the repository root because
# the root is the live home directory.
#
# Every entry below is a reference this change did not own: three comments in
# .gitignore and six files under .local/bin. Each names what the fix is; when
# the file is fixed the entry must be deleted. The goal is an empty file.
#
# Detectors: .github/scripts/check-paths.mjs

.gitignore:52|checkout-location|comment explaining why the shell's tree is excluded from this repository's tracked set; fix = name the tree without its location (or point at its README)
.gitignore:102|checkout-location|comment explaining the three absolute symlinks into the shell's tree; fix = same as line 52
.gitignore:217|checkout-location|comment explaining why the shell's tree needs its own re-include rule; fix = same as line 52
.local/bin/host-apply:22|checkout-location|comment comparing this script's sudo use with the shell tree's setup.sh; fix = name the tree without its location
.local/bin/lib/promptd-client.sh:17|checkout-location|live default for the router path — the same hardcoded-checkout bug the shell's own router carried; fix = resolve the router from this script's own location (readlink -f "$BASH_SOURCE"/$0, two directories up), never overwrite a PROMPTD_ROUTE the environment supplied
.local/bin/pi-guard-probe:33|foreign-home|test fixture path in a guard probe, read by nothing; fix = a path that names no home (e.g. /opt/example/y.ts)
.local/bin/tinshell-handoff-resume.sh:21|runtime-id|hardcoded runtime uid; fix = ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/run/user/$(id -u)}
.local/bin/tinshell-handoff-resume.sh:23|runtime-id|hardcoded runtime uid; fix = the same expansion, then ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/bus
.local/bin/tinshell-handoff-resume.sh:24|runtime-id|hardcoded runtime uid; fix = the same expansion, then ${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/hypr
